settings.qualitaet_hilfe: Auto detects your device and picks a fitting profile.
settings.aufloesung_hilfe: Lower renders fewer pixels (FSR) — the UI stays sharp.
settings.bildrate_hilfe: 120 only takes effect on ProMotion displays.
settings.sichtweite_hilfe: Only staggers decoration — goals always stay visible.
settings.qualitaet_gesenkt_text: The frame rate stayed low for a while — graphics were lowered one step.
settings.ui_skalierung_hilfe: Makes buttons and panels bigger or smaller overall.
settings.textgroesse_hilfe: Applies on top of UI size, but only to text.
settings.safe_area_hilfe: Extra distance from notch and corners, in pixels.
settings.haendigkeit_hilfe: Mirrors the touch buttons — text stays readable.
settings.schema_hilfe: Reins: swipe to steer, tap to speed up.
settings.lenkassistent_hilfe: Gently pulls you into the curve while riding.
settings.haptik_hilfe: On iPhone this only works in the signed app.
settings.farbmodus_hilfe: Shifts colors as an aid — shapes and icons stay the primary language.
settings.notify_ruhe_hilfe: Nights stay silent — anything due arrives in the morning.
settings.notify_hinweis: Honestly: without a signed iOS app, alerts only arrive while the game is open — shown as a banner on top.
settings.autosave_hilfe: Off: the game only saves when you quit.
settings.tutorial_reset_ok: Done — the hints will show up again.
settings.credits_hinweis: Sounds and music under CC-BY license — thanks to:
credits_liste: “Horse gallop on different surfaces” — congusbongus, CC-BY 4.0 (with samples by moodyfingers and Twigy233, CC-BY 4.0)
“Free Crowd Cheering Sounds” — Gregor Quendel, CC-BY 4.0
settings.haptik_an_hilfe: Gently vibrates on taps, successes and warnings.

dev.warnung_text: This menu is meant for testing. Changes permanently mark your save as edited. A backup is created automatically before risky actions.
dev.aktiviert: Developer mode is on — tap the DEV badge.
dev.cooldown: Too many attempts — wait a moment.
dev.glow_leer: No game throttled — all runs within budget.
dev.glow_reset_ok: Glow markers cleared — next runs measure fresh.
dev.markierung_hinweis: Every change creates a backup first and marks the save as edited.
dev.pferd_fehler: No space or no ranch — nothing happened.
dev.save_hinweis: Import runs through the normal, validating transfer path — nothing is overwritten without asking.
